$comment: The one list of UI languages (ADR 0028). Every client and the hub read it: the language pickers, <html lang/dir>, the fallback chain, Intl formatting. `pnpm i18n:new <code>` adds an entry and every platform's catalogue; `pnpm i18n:check` keeps them in step. Pseudo-locales are for tests only and never listed to a person.

pseudo.$comment: About 40% longer, accented Latin, in brackets: finds hard-coded text, truncation and overflow.
Arabic stretched by about 40%: long right-to-left text.
Full-width CJK: wide glyphs, no spaces to break at.
Thai with stacked tone marks and Vietnamese-style diacritics: tall glyphs that clip under a tight line height.
English with each string's key appended in zero-width characters: measures the room of every label (pnpm i18n:limits --measure). Never a journey's locale.
